hbs.title: Net State Value Added by Economic Activity - Construction (Current Prices)

meta.coverage: Net State Value Added by Economic Activity - Construction (Current Prices) (base 2011-12): RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 39
meta.note: DBIE report 1589, data provider "Main". Values exactly as DBIE serves them; each series carries its unit (scripts/lib/products/states.mjs HBS_UNITS, read from the table's unit column and divisor). Periods: fiscal years, dated at April. Dimensions: Dseries Description; measures: value. Jammu & Kashmir to 2018-19 (with Ladakh) and from 2019-20 (the UT) are separate series; 2019-20 straddles the change of 31 October 2019.
